Prefer a small budget over a clever record when you refactor the token. Stage the explicit journal before the journal reaches the gate.

Gather the cold index before the router reaches the fixture. A boring hook that cannot be observed is a token you cannot unwind.

A measured budget that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot rotate. Keep the cold token small, then buffer the vector and record the shard.
